objective: Collapse open-ended tool/domain capability enumeration into the smallest sound Opus-specific target: the model policy over its documented interaction interface, while preserving every observable target behavior and refusing to credit external tool computation to the model.

current_first_party_facts.fact: Claude Opus 5.5 is a fixed current model with documented text-and-image input to text output, adaptive thinking, a 1M context window and 128K normal max output.
Claude user-defined client tools execute in the caller application; Claude emits tool_use with a tool name and JSON arguments, the application executes the operation, and returns tool_result.
Server tools are executed on Anthropic infrastructure and client tools are executed by the application; the model chooses tool calls through the documented tool interface.
The Messages API exposes structured input/output content blocks and tool schemas/results, including text, image, document/search-result content, thinking, tool_use and tool_result semantics.
Claude.ai and Claude mobile apps use a documented system prompt associated with the Opus 5.5 model; those prompt updates do not redefine the model API itself.
